_changelog_from_3.2: Warren Buffett mascot size rule NEW: corner mascot = ~30% of primary human subject's rendered size (new v4.0 rule)
Buffett role classification introduced: mascot_corner_30pct | central_protagonist_full | cta_podium_medium
CTA reward PDF report now auto-generated by new Agent 12 (CTA Report Builder)
Data freshness rule: T-1 business day close for numerical data (prices, indices, rates), latest release for indicators (CPI, NFP). News/analysis/policy unrestricted if from credible sources.
Batch pacing for image prompt delivery: cover(1) + body_pairs(2 each) + cta(1) structure
v3.3 acronym gloss officially merged: Orchestrator manages post-wide acronym registry, Agent 10 places in empty corners
_changelog_from_3.1: Cover exclusivity: HOOK-only visual tokens forbidden on non-cover slides
Body font: Courier Prime → Roboto-like modern sans-serif
Light theme: light_grid → light_lined (horizontal ruled only, brighter cream)
Top scrapbook prop: binder_clip DEPRECATED → HOOK=spring+pencil, non-HOOK=tape/pin/sticker
source: 18 original slides analyzed across 3 Instagram posts

data_freshness_policy_v4._critical: v4.0 NEW: Numerical data must be T-1 (last completed trading day close). Indicators use latest release. News/analysis/policy unrestricted.
data_freshness_policy_v4.t1_calculation_rule: If generation day is weekday → T-1 = previous business day. If Monday → Friday close. Holiday rollback: use last completed business day close.
data_freshness_policy_v4.reference_timezone: US Eastern Time (4:00 PM ET close)

text_rendering_rule._critical: Only literal words meant to appear on the slide are passed as 'text to render'. JSON keys, CSS strings, citation markers, hex codes, units MUST NEVER appear in the rendered image.

light_lined._v3.2_note: horizontal lines only, brighter cream (NOT grid)
light_lined.background_texture: bright warm off-white cream paper with ONLY horizontal ruled lines (~8mm apart, soft faded blue-gray). NO vertical lines. NO grid crosses.
light_lined.prompt_description_for_gemini: bright cream off-white notebook paper with ONLY horizontal ruled lines, soft faded blue-gray rules about 8mm apart, NO vertical lines, NO grid pattern, subtle paper grain

dark_neon.background_color_meaning: pure black with chromatic aberration rainbow glow (neon reflection)

red_devil.background_color_meaning: deep crimson red with subtle grunge texture

newspaper.background: cream paper with torn newspaper clippings in corners

night_forest.background: dark photo of forested road at night, muted blue-gray

cover_exclusive_tokens._critical: RESERVED for HOOK slide ONLY. Enforced by Agent 9, 10, audited by Agent 11.

notebook_spring_with_pencil.description: Full-width metal spiral-bound notebook binding across top edge — silver/chrome evenly-spaced coils — with exactly ONE yellow wooden pencil inserted diagonally through one coil

sole_focal_subject.description: Single large central subject carries the slide

account_handle_watermark._purpose: Owner branding — always show the account handle 'broisinvesting' as a faint top-center watermark on the cover only, so the series is identifiable at a glance.
account_handle_watermark.placement: top_center, immediately below the notebook spring binding and clearly above the oversized hero headline
account_handle_watermark.size_hint: very small, roughly 1.6-2.2% of slide height (about half body size or smaller), never competing with the headline
account_handle_watermark.color_meaning: faded pencil-gray / muted graphite — low-contrast, subtly ghosted onto the paper
account_handle_watermark.font_character: modern clean sans-serif, Roboto-like, light or regular weight, slightly wider letter spacing
account_handle_watermark.decoration: no underline, no box, no @ prefix unless explicitly requested
account_handle_watermark.intent_phrase_for_gemini: subtle ghosted handle watermark reading 'broisinvesting' in faded pencil-gray modern sans-serif, very small and recessive, sitting just under the spring binding and well above the headline so it never competes with the title or main subject
account_handle_watermark.forbidden_on: ALL non-HOOK slides — never render the handle anywhere on body, evidence, irony, catalyst, omen, conclusion, or CTA slides

typography._v3.2_retained_in_v4: Body = Roboto-like modern sans-serif. Headline = classic newspaper serif. Subtitle = +10% body size.

headline_serif.prompt_phrasing: classic bold newspaper serif typeface, deep black ink

body_sans.character: modern clean sans-serif, slightly rounded terminals, highly legible, humanist
body_sans.prompt_phrasing: modern clean sans-serif typeface, Roboto-like, medium weight, highly legible, rounded

subtitle_sans.character: modern clean sans-serif, moderately prominent, noticeably larger than body
subtitle_sans.prompt_phrasing: subtitle in modern clean sans-serif, Roboto-like, rendered noticeably larger than the body text, moderately prominent (about 1.1x body size)

small_caps_label.prompt_phrasing: small uppercase label, wide letter spacing, modern clean sans-serif

acronym_gloss_v4._new_v4_note: Footnote-style acronym gloss (from v3.3 acronym minipatch, now official)
acronym_gloss_v4.prompt_phrasing: small muted-gray italic sans-serif, approximately half body text size, recessive margin footnote

typography.universal_rule: 1 slide = 1 Serif headline + 1-2 Sans body blocks. No third font family.
typography.prompt_phrasing_for_gemini: 'Roboto-like' as style hint is OK. 'Roboto' as literal render string is FORBIDDEN.

warren_buffett_mascot_sizing_v4._critical_new_v4: Buffett mascot size depends on role. Corner mascots are ~30% of the primary human subject's rendered size.

mascot_corner_30pct.description: Recurring reaction character placed in a corner (usually bottom_left)
mascot_corner_30pct.size_rule: approximately 30% of the rendered size of the primary human subject on the same slide
mascot_corner_30pct.prompt_phrasing_template: In the {zone} corner, place a photorealistic cutout of Warren Buffett with {pose_description}, ... Render him at approximately 30% of the size of {primary_subject_id}'s rendered size, clearly smaller as a corner mascot reaction character.

central_protagonist_full.description: Buffett IS the main subject of the slide (topic about Buffett himself, or he's the story)
central_protagonist_full.size_rule: large, central — keep full presence (no 30% rule)
central_protagonist_full.prompt_phrasing_template: In the middle center, place a large photorealistic cutout of Warren Buffett...

cta_podium_medium.description: CTA slide — authoritative endorsement at Berkshire annual meeting podium
cta_podium_medium.prompt_phrasing_template: In the middle center, place a photorealistic cutout of Warren Buffett at the Berkshire Hathaway annual meeting podium with microphone...

danger_red.color_meaning_hint: crimson red marker (internal ref #C8302C, never as render text)

catalog.style: silver chrome spiral-bound notebook coil across full top edge with ONE yellow wooden pencil inserted diagonally through one coil

catalog.placement: top_center, just below the notebook spring binding and above the oversized headline
catalog.style: literal lowercase text 'broisinvesting' in faded pencil-gray modern sans-serif, very small (~half body size), recessive low-contrast watermark, no underline, no box

catalog.placement: corners of non-HOOK slides or of images
catalog.style: beige, slightly angled, slightly curling edges
small torn paper sticker, irregular edge

deprecated._reason: Replaced by notebook spring on cover and tape/pin on others

warren_buffett_mascot.description: Warren Buffett photo cutout. Thin white hair, large glasses, typically gray/navy suit. Varied expressive photos preferred over corporate headshots.
warren_buffett_mascot.visual_treatment: Photorealistic cutout (NOT illustrated, NOT 3D). Always with torn paper edge. Slight tilt -4 to +4°.
warren_buffett_mascot.frequency_target: ~40% of slides (selective; HOOK + CTA + 1-2 reactive body slides — see 03_MASTER_PROMPT rule 1-A; allowed range 30%-50%)

real_people_cutouts.treatment: background removed, torn paper frame, photorealistic
real_people_cutouts._note: Warren Buffett excluded from this pool (he's the mascot). If Buffett IS the topic, he becomes central_protagonist.

pixel_error_dialog.description: Windows 95 red title bar ERROR, warning triangle, gray body with pixel text, OK button

company_logo_badges.style: white rounded rectangle, slightly tilted, subtle shadow

data_visualization_spec.style_note: Data visuals must look like SCREENSHOTS, not redrawn.

cta_pdf_charts_v4._new: Agent 4 selects 2 candidates (primary + secondary) for CTA PDF reward report
cta_pdf_charts_v4.primary_role: single most compelling chart, large display in PDF

typical_zone_allocations.bottom_left: Warren Buffett mascot (30% rule when corner case)

cta_patterns: Comment '[1-WORD in red]' + promise + deliverable screenshot + Buffett at annual meeting podium

acronym_gloss_rules_v4._source: Officially merged from v3.3 acronym minipatch
acronym_gloss_rules_v4.trigger: Any 2-5 letter all-uppercase acronym NOT in common_whitelist
acronym_gloss_rules_v4.selection_rule: If >2 specialist acronyms on a slide, keep the 2 most difficult
acronym_gloss_rules_v4.placement_rule: Place in an empty corner. If 2, prefer grouping on same side (left or right).
acronym_gloss_rules_v4.styling: muted gray italic sans-serif, ~0.5x body size
acronym_gloss_rules_v4.deduplication: Once glossed in a post, do NOT gloss again on subsequent slides (Orchestrator tracks registry)

cta_pdf_report_v4._new: CTA reward PDF generated by Agent 12
structure: Key Data Points (3-5 bullets with T-1 dates)
cta_pdf_report_v4.data_freshness: Same rules as card news: T-1 for numbers, latest release for indicators, unrestricted for news/analysis

batch_pacing_v4._new: Orchestrator delivers image prompt JSONs to user in batches
batch_pacing_v4.odd_body_count_handling: If non-cover non-cta count is odd, the last body slide forms a solo batch before CTA

prohibited: Modern sans-serif for HEADLINES (Helvetica, Arial, Inter, SF Pro, Roboto). Headlines must be classic serif.
Unicode emoji in text (except speech-bubble UI)
Rendering JSON keys, hex codes, font specs, or citation tags AS visible text
Grid backgrounds for light_lined (must be horizontal ruled only)
notebook_spring or pencil on non-HOOK slides
v4.0: Warren Buffett at full size when role is mascot_corner (must be ~30% of primary subject)
v4.0: Using numerical data without T-1 attestation
v4.0: Using 'latest' prices without explicit date
v4.0: Delivering more than 2 image prompt JSONs per batch (except cover=1, cta=1)
v4.0: CTA slide without accompanying cta_report.pdf
v4.0: Re-glossing an acronym already glossed earlier in the same post
